body:
Working entry (`chk-gvely5gr`, Epoch 5 — The fleet: lineage, launch and windows), verbatim: «`viola open` — a
terminal window per session beside its parent; closed flag allowlist, no shell; window identity and origin in its own
state, logged codes-only».

- A new CLI verb `viola open` that brings up a new terminal window running a named wrapped session (`viola run` under
  that name), placed beside its parent's window on Hyprland and left to the window manager elsewhere.

- The verb returns only once the session is live, records the window's identity and the open's origin in the
  instance's own state, and names the calling agent as the parent when none is given (the inherited session name, as
  `viola run` already reads it).

- A closed flag allowlist: an open carrying a flag outside it is refused before anything starts; no shell line is built
  from the given arguments, whatever characters they hold; the terminal is a direct spawn.

- Logging codes-only: no window title, class or other Hyprland reply string reaches a log line or an error (the
  security floor's Hyprland clause).
- A security decision entry naming the argument surface, the allowlist and the agent path (v2-08's acceptance).
- v2-07 (the open: window, placement, live return, identity and origin recorded, calling agent as parent).
- v2-08 (the closed allowlist, no shell line, the security decision entry).

# Phase directive — «`viola open`» (Epoch 5, viola-0.2.0; the head entry at `ddf3b411`)

**WHAT IS AN INPUT, AND WHAT IS NOT.** Of the folder this directive stands in, the ONLY files you read or snap are
this directive and the relay files a later send names. Nothing else under it is read, cited or snapped. A fact the
plan needs and this directive does not state is ASKED of the overseer in the P3 block, never looked up.

The operator answers through the overseer's dialogs: raise NO question dialog for him. A
fork that is his is written to `{run_dir}/founder-forks.md` (the question, the options in order with each one's
cost, the recommendation marked) and the step stops there, saying so. A technical fork is answered by the
overseer's relay at once. **This phase makes NO live start, opens, moves, focuses or closes NO window, sends NO key, and reads nothing
of the operator's real `~/.claude*`.** In your chat messages name a compiled screen literal, never print it.

## Facts, measured by the overseer 2026-11-23T11:59Z — cite them as this directive's

- A bare `claude` on this host is 2.1.330, and THIS session runs it under the product built from `f274938f`. The
  tree at `ddf3b411`: position 130 records, 0 pending; coverage `verified 25/37 · deferred 2 · planned 10`. The
  entry's head, verbatim: «`viola open` — a terminal window per session beside its parent; closed flag allowlist,
  no shell; window identity and origin in its own state, logged codes-only». It carries THREE carries
  (`cry-ypbg67h6`: the seam's `exec` window-placement dispatch and the `monitors` query, each a new request, its
  argv measured live, recorded by the tap and replayed by the fake; `cry-bcosdllb`: settle the provisional
  `HYPRCTL_DEADLINE`; `cry-ejfh3wh6`: the `hyprctl reply` Boundary row's witness must drive the read past its cap).
- The capabilities the entry can claim: v2-07 («From the CLI and from an agent's own shell, an open brings up a new
  terminal window running the named wrapped session, placed beside its parent's window on Hyprland and left to
  the window manager elsewhere; it returns only once the session is live, records the window's identity and the
  open's origin, and names the calling agent as the parent when none is given.») and v2-08 («An open carrying a
  flag outside the closed allowlist is refused before anything starts; no shell line is ever built from the given
  arguments, whatever characters they hold; a security decision entry names the argument surface, the allowlist
  and the agent path.»).
- The tree holds, since the last two chunks: a `lineage {parent, role}` line and a `launch {model, effort}` line
  at every start; `viola run --parent/--role/--model/--effort`; the inherited session name read as the parent
  when no `--parent` is given.
- **The operator's desktop session is LOCKED now** (`hyprctl locked` read true at 2026-11-23T11:59Z) and he is away from the
  host. Nobody unlocks it. A READ-ONLY query of the compositor (`hyprctl -j` monitors, clients, version and the
  like, nothing dispatched) is allowed in this phase; anything that opens, places, focuses or closes a window, or
  types a key, is NOT — it is a reading the operator grants, at the host.
- Another project works on this host: a gate red with no failed assertion is read against `python3
  ~/dev/projects/additional/andromedaV3/andromeda-overseer/docs/tools/hostwatch.py read --from <the entry's start>
  --to <now>` first and never re-run for green; read `df -m /tmp` beside it — the test homes refuse below their
  headroom floor, and the host record does not see that cause.

## The directive

1. Scope is the route entry as it stands at `ddf3b411`, its three carries and v2-07 / v2-08, nothing wider. Every
   carry is disposed by name — taken, or left with its reason and its next owner. Say at P1 what «verified» can
   rest on HERE for each clause of v2-07 and v2-08: which clauses a fake compositor and the fake agent can prove,
   and which need a real window on the operator's host.
2. **The measurements come FIRST, at P3, each from a test, a no-start and no-window probe, the recorded tap
   fixtures or a read-only compositor query, each a number or a closed word:** what the Hyprland seam holds today
   (its requests, what the tap recorded, what the fake replays, the provisional deadline and what was ever timed
   against it); what the compositor's own help and the recorded fixtures say of a placement dispatch and of
   `monitors` on this host's version; how a terminal is started here without a shell line (which terminal, by
   which name resolution, with which argv) and what tells its window apart once it exists (a class, a title, a
   pid, an address) — from the read-only queries and the code, no window opened; what an «agent's own shell»
   gives an open (the inherited names) and what `run` already does with them; what «live» means for the return
   (which record or reply) and its time bound today. Say what of all this is the fake's and unmeasured live.
3. **Forks that are the operator's, each written with its options priced:** the verb's argument surface and the
   closed flag allowlist, member by member; which terminal is started and how it is chosen (fixed, a config key,
   the desktop's own resolver); what «beside its parent» is on Hyprland, and what an open does when the parent has
   no window, is on another workspace, or the desktop is locked; what an open does off Hyprland; every NEW closed
   word, exit, refusal and hint; every new time bound and its value (the wait for «live», the compositor read's
   settled deadline); the record's shape (a new event kind or fields — the window's identity and the open's
   origin — what `list` and `--json` show of them) and whether a window's identity is a name another session may
   read; **the live readings this chunk needs at his host — each named with what it opens, how many times, what it
   leaves behind and how it is closed; they are his to grant, at the host, unlocked**; and A SPLIT: say plainly
   whether one implement window holds the entry with its three carries, and if not, the split you would make and
   what each part claims.
4. **Every master row whose words the change reaches: search ALL seven masters before the block is written** and
   name every reached row with the ones read as not reached beside them — by the counted literals a row or a test
   pins (a start's record count, the event kinds, a verb table, an exit-cause table, the board's columns), not
   only by the new names, and by the words «replays no», «never», «only» where a ratified row forbids what the
   entry builds. A new time bound whose list cell is full lands as a row of its own beside the list; no member's
   words shortened.
5. **At P3's END, before P4:** write ONE block in `founder-forks.md` with your window, the measurements, the
   design each fork leans to, every reached row, the forks that are the operator's, and whether one implement
   window holds it. **If the block holds NO fork of his, say so in its first line and go on to P4 without
   waiting.** A split is his.
6. At a P3 block say what each new record writes to DISK, what outlives a SIGKILL, and what of a parent's
   identity (a path, a session id, a socket) lands in a file another session or a public tree can read.
7. A new test child or a fake-agent behaviour is named, with the case that proves it and the bound every test
   that waits on it takes under the 20 s lint.
8. Every control stands on an entry filtered to its guard's own cases AND building the whole workspace where the
   case needs a root binary; the bound that applies is the entry's own timeout key. Every filter term of a gate
   entry SELECTS at least one test under its layer flag. An expect atom must be able to fail; a word that may
   honestly read two ways is a READING recorded, not a failing atom; an after-read of state OTHER actors move is
   keyed to the round leg. A test that skips prints its reason. The plan names operator entries by their run
   text. Each capped start, if any, names what it needs ABSENT or PRESENT on disk outside the tree and the
   no-start entry that reads it.
9. No mutation run. A test that waits takes a bound under the 20 s lint. Every TEST start runs under a test-owned
   user home. Read `df` before a whole rebuild.
10. A fold is decided at the PHASE. A guard's or the permission classifier's refusal is never routed around: stop
    and tell the overseer. On an account-limit refusal, stop where you are.
11. Call NO scheduled-wake or timer tool, with any argument. End every process you start; remove no scratch
    clone by a recursive delete — name it on the card instead. Leaves hold no figure the code states.
12. Run the phase exactly as the letters say (the install changed today: gate v1.39, rec v1.54, fanout v52 — read
    the letters as they stand, not from memory). On the P5 card, in one block, verbatim where a tool printed it:
    the union's per-master lines and the `rows-union` line; whether EVERY cited row is in the union or its
    standing list; the round pre-flight's lines if the plan holds a round; every `[RETYPED]` line and re-spawn;
    every non-zero exit, refusal, `UNPARSED` / `INDETERMINATE` / `NOT DERIVED` line; every place a letter was
    wrong or silent.
